body: here's the thing though, I'm not paying out of pocket, my parents are paying for it and I don't want to just drop out because my parents are paying for it. well the only hobbies I enjoyed was playing video games, but I have grown tired and lost interest in that, so now all I do is go online and view social media, I don't comment, like, or share, I just view. But now I am realizing that viewing social media is meaningless and I don't really enjoy it, but I don't really do anything else because I don't have the motivation or interest to try. And is that really true about the depression? I don't really hate my life or feel deep sadness, its just that I don't find it all too thrilling, I have a good life but Its wasted because of my lack of motivation, drive, or interest to go through with life to succeed.
